content:
**Bloatfly Loaf** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Bloatfly Meat which has been combined with Glowing Fungus and baked into a loaf. It gives a 60 minute boost to Radiation Resistance while restoring a very large amount of HP and a large amount of hunger at the cost of a negligible dose of rads.
